subject: SIG intake: section claims, owners, and evidence queue
messages:
From: Jacob Stern <j.stern@finwave.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finwave.com
Date: 2025-06-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: SIG intake request — FinWave initial questionnaire attached

Hi Rohan / Laura,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached is the SIG spreadsheet we use for initial vendor intake (FinWave internal). We need the completed questionnaire and an index of supporting artifacts (e.g., policies, screenshots, audit logs) within two weeks if possible — deadline: 2025-07-12.

Top priorities for our audit team: identity & access management sections, key management, and logging/monitoring. If you can indicate section owners, backups, and an estimated readiness date for each section that would be very helpful.

Attachments: FinWave_SIG_2025.xlsx (SIG XLSX; ~230 fields), evidence_index_2025.csv (optional template)

Let us know if you prefer a short kickoff call — we can do 30 minutes next week.

Thanks,
Jacob Stern
FinWave — Vendor Risk Team
security@finwave.com

---

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
To: FinWave Security <security@finwave.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-28T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG intake request — FinWave initial questionnaire attached

Jacob — thanks for the send. Laura and I reviewed the spreadsheet briefly. We'll triage and propose owners for each SIG section by EOD tomorrow.

Quick intake plan (proposed):
- Triage run (today): map SIG sections -> internal teams (security, infra, product ops).
- Owner claims (by 2025-06-29): each owner picks primary + backup and an evidence lead.
- Evidence collection sprint (2025-06-30 -> 2025-07-10): owners upload artifacts to the shared Drive and populate the evidence_index.
- Final review & delivery (by 2025-07-11) to meet your 2025-07-12 deadline.

Initial ask for our internal group: Monica, Markus, Laura — please claim sections below (reply inline with PRIMARY / BACKUP and estimate for evidence):
- IAM (users/groups/roles)
- Key management (KMS, rotation, HSM)
- Logging & monitoring (log retention, SIEM)
- Change management / release controls
- Data classification & handling

I've created a shared Drive folder (link below) and a lightweight tracker so we can see progress at a glance. If anyone needs help drafting artifacts (e.g., policy snippets) ping me and I can pair with you.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cFINWAVE_SIG
JIRA ticket: SEC-4513
HubSpot record: 8902345

Thanks — Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Head of Security Operations | Redwood Inference
---

Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, FinWave Security <security@finwave.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T14:23:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG intake request — section claims and evidence ETA

Following Rohan's plan — claiming sections and providing ETA for evidence upload. I'll update the Drive evidence_index as I collect artifacts.

Claims (PRIMARY / BACKUP / evidence ETA):
- IAM: Monica Patel (PRIMARY) / Laura Bennett (BACKUP) — ETA 2025-07-03 (users & group screenshots, role mapping doc, SSO config)
- Key management (KMS): Markus Klein (PRIMARY) / Rohan Mehta (BACKUP) — ETA 2025-07-05 (KMS architecture diagram, rotation schedule, HSM attestation)
- Logging & monitoring: Laura Bennett (PRIMARY) / Monica Patel (BACKUP) — ETA 2025-07-04 (retention policy, sample logs, SIEM ingest proof)
- Change management / release controls: Markus Klein (PRIMARY) / Laura Bennett (BACKUP) — ETA 2025-07-06 (change rubric, release checklist, PR audit trail)
- Data classification & handling: Monica Patel (PRIMARY) / Markus Klein (BACKUP) — ETA 2025-07-03 (data inventory export, classification policy)

Notes / blockers:
- For KMS/HSM attestation we may need Viktor from infra; I'll loop him if Markus can't access the export.
- Some logs are stored across regions; Laura will scope a subset that satisfies FinWave's retention questions.

I've added short notes in the Drive folder under /evidence_index_2025.csv. If FinWave prefers, we can schedule a 20-minute sync to walk through the mapping tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Manager, Security Programs | Redwood Inference

Date: 2025-07-02T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: SIG intake request — section claims and evidence queue

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear owner rosters — this is exactly what our audit team needs. A couple quick clarification items before we start formal review:

1) For Key management: can you confirm where key rotation schedules are stored and whether there's an export we can review? If there's an HSM attestation PDF or vendor statement (e.g., AWS CloudHSM) please upload it to the Drive.
2) For Logging: sample logs with redacted PII are fine — can you include a short readme describing how to query for the window you captured?

If it's easier, we can take the Drive link and open a single ticket for each evidence bundle to speed validation. Otherwise we'll wait for the evidence_index CSV to be populated and then begin review.

DocuSign (NDA amendment): https://docusign.com/someplaceholder (if needed)

Thanks — we'll plan a 15–20 minute spot check session on 2025-07-06 if the evidence is in place.

Best,
Jacob Stern
Vendor Risk, FinWave
